opportunities.name: Plan a movie night and draft an invite email
opportunities.description: For a given movie title, look up its IMDb rating, director and runtime, get its Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score, then write an email to a friend inviting them to watch it on a given day.
steps: Open imdb.com and dismiss the cookie banner if shown
Type the movie title in the search box and open the matching title result
Note the IMDb rating, director and runtime
Open rottentomatoes.com and dismiss the cookie banner if shown
Search for the movie title and open the matching movie result
Note the Tomatometer score
Open the email compose page
Enter the recipient's email address in To
Set Subject to 'Movie night <day>: <title>'
Set Body to 'Hi <name>, <day> we watch <title> (<director>, <runtime>): IMDb <rating>, Tomatometer <score>%.'
Send the draft (in the recording it was discarded)

instances.values: Arrival; lena@example.com; Friday; Denis Villeneuve, 1h 56m, IMDb 7.9, Tomatometer 94%
Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; Hayao Miyazaki, 2h 4m, IMDb 8.6, Tomatometer 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel; aisha@example.com; Sunday; Wes Anderson, 1h 39m, IMDb 8.1, Tomatometer 92%

opportunities.name: Research an npm package and log its stats in Notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package name, collect its latest version, weekly downloads and license from npmjs.com, then its stars, open issues and last release date from the GitHub repo, and save a one-line summary in Notes.
steps: Open npmjs.com
Type the package name in the search box and submit
Open the exact-match package from the results
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the Repository link to open the GitHub repo
Note the star count, open issues count and latest release date
Open the Notes app
Add the note '<pkg>: v<version>, <downloads>/week, <license>, <stars> stars, <issues> open issues, last release <date>'

instances.values: axios: v1.20.0, 96,527,621/week, MIT, 109k stars, 57 open issues, last release Sep 13, 2026 (the user opened @nestjs/axios by mistake first)
lodash: v4.18.1, 131,289,453/week, MIT, 61.4k stars, 56 open issues, last release Apr 1, 2026
express: v5.3.0, 117,734,595/week, MIT, 69.6k stars, 108 open issues, last release Oct 9, 2026 (paused by the Grand Budapest Hotel movie task)

opportunities.name: Find a recipe and its origin and log them in Notes
opportunities.description: For a given dish, open the top Allrecipes result to get its rating, time, servings and key ingredients, look up its place of origin on Wikipedia, and save a one-line summary in Notes.
steps: Open allrecipes.com and accept the consent dialog if shown
Search for the dish name
Open the first or top-rated recipe in the results
Note the recipe name, star rating, total time, servings and the first few ingredients
Open Wikipedia and search for the dish
Open the dish article and read 'Place of origin' in the infobox
Open the Notes app
Add the note '<dish> for <servings>: <recipe> (<stars> stars, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <origin>'
